```mermaid
  F --> P["Power plan: ring, stripes, follow pins"]
  P --> PL["Placement + pre-CTS opt (setup)"]
  PL --> C["CTS + post-CTS opt (setup + hold)"]
  C --> R["Routing + post-route opt (SI)"]
  R --> FILL["Filler / metal fill"]
  FILL --> SO["Sign-off: STA (PT), DRC/LVS (Calibre), IR/EM"]
  SO --> GDS["Stream out GDSII"]
```

| 階段 | 重點 | 常見問題 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Floorplan | core utilization（約 60~75%）、macro 擺放、IO | congestion、macro channel |
| Power plan | ring / stripe 寬度與密度 | IR drop、EM |
| Placement | 標準元件擺放、timing-driven | congestion、setup |
| CTS | clock tree 平衡 skew / latency | skew、transition |
| Routing | global → track → detail route | DRC、crosstalk |
| Sign-off | 多 corner STA、物理驗證 | ECO 迭代 |

### Explanation
- Pre-CTS 只修 setup（clock ideal）；post-CTS 用 propagated clock，開始修 hold。
- Routing 後加入 SI（crosstalk）分析，再做 post-route opt。
- 不收斂時用 ECO（engineering change order）局部修改。

### Corner cases & pitfalls
- Floorplan 是最關鍵的一步，macro 擺錯後面怎麼優化都救不回來。

### Follow-ups
- **APR 後如何確認功能沒變？** LEC（netlist vs APR netlist）+ post-sim。

title: Power ring / power plan 的作用是什麼
answer: 讓 VDD/GND 均勻分佈、減少 IR drop、支援大電流；IR drop 過大可加寬 power ring、改善 power mesh 密度。
solution:
**Key idea:** Power ring 圍繞 core（或 macro）提供低阻抗的 VDD/VSS 主幹；stripes（power mesh）把電源均勻分佈到晶片內部；follow pins（standard cell rails）把電送到每個 cell。目的是**降低 IR drop、避免 EM、支援大電流**。

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  PAD["Power pads (VDD/VSS)"] --> RING["Core ring (寬金屬，高層)"]
  RING --> STRIPE["Stripes / mesh (垂直 + 水平)"]
  STRIPE --> RAIL["Follow pins (M1 rails)"]
  RAIL --> CELL["Standard cells"]
  RING --> MRING["Macro ring"]
  MRING --> MACRO["SRAM / IP"]
```

| 元素 | 作用 | 設計考量 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Core ring | 電源主幹，連 pad | 寬度依總電流與 EM 限制 |
| Stripes | 縮短電源到 cell 的距離 | 間距、寬度、層別；太密吃 routing 資源 |
| Follow pins | cell row 的 VDD/VSS rail | 低層金屬 |
| Via array | 層間連接 | 足夠數量降低電阻與 EM |

### Explanation
- 簡化估算：IR drop = I × R，ring 越寬、stripe 越密，R 越小。
- 常見問題：IR drop 過大 → 原因可能是 ring 寬度不足、stripe 太稀疏、pad 太少；解法是加寬 ring、提高 mesh 密度、增加 power pad、加 decap。

### Corner cases & pitfalls
- Power mesh 佔用 routing track，太密造成 signal congestion，需在 IR 與 routability 之間取捨。

### Follow-ups
- **flip-chip 與 wire-bond 的差異？** flip-chip 的 bump 分佈在整個晶片面上，IR drop 比周邊 pad 小很多。

title: CTS（Clock Tree Synthesis）的作用與流程？如何降低 clock skew
solution:
**Key idea:** CTS 在 placement 之後、routing 之前，用 clock buffer/inverter 建立 clock 分佈網路，目標是 **最小化 skew、控制 insertion delay（latency）、滿足 transition / cap 限制**，並兼顧功耗與面積。

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  ROOT["clock source / PLL"] --> B1["CTS buffer"]
  B1 --> B2["buffer L"]
  B1 --> B3["buffer R"]
  B2 --> F1["FF group 1"]
  B2 --> F2["FF group 2"]
  B3 --> F3["FF group 3"]
  B3 --> ICG["ICG"] --> F4["gated FFs"]
```

| 指標 | 意義 | 目標 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Skew | 不同 sink 的 clock 到達時間差 | 越小越好（或 useful skew） |
| Insertion delay (latency) | source → sink 延遲 | 小，降低 OCV 影響 |
| Transition | clock 邊緣斜率 | 滿足 max transition |
| Power | clock tree 佔動態功耗 30%+ | 減少 buffer 數量 |

### Explanation
- 流程：設定 CTS spec（target skew、max transition、buffer/inverter list、NDR）→ 建 tree（clustering、buffering、balancing）→ post-CTS opt（修 hold、setup）。
- 降低 skew 的方法：H-tree / clock mesh 結構、平衡 buffer 層數、clock net 用 NDR（double width/spacing）並 shielding、clock cells 放在一起避免 OCV、balance 不同 ICG 分支。
- CTS 會增加 buffer/inverter，可能造成 congestion、crosstalk。

### Corner cases & pitfalls
- 同步介面跨 block 時要 balance 多個 clock tree（clock group balancing）。
- Pre-CTS timing 用 ideal clock，post-CTS 必須切換到 propagated clock，hold 才有意義。

### Follow-ups
- **Useful skew？** 刻意讓 critical path 的 capture clock 晚到以借時間。
- **CCOpt？** Cadence 的 concurrent clock & data optimization，CTS 與 datapath 優化同時進行。

title: 什麼是 IR drop？如何改善
solution:
**Key idea:** 電流流經電源網路的電阻造成電壓下降：cell 實際拿到的電壓 = VDD − I·R（加上 VSS 端的 ground bounce）。電壓變低 → cell 變慢 → timing fail，嚴重時功能錯誤。

Worked example：一條 stripe 電阻 0.05 Ω，流過 1 A → 壓降 50 mV；VDD 0.8 V 時約 6%，cell delay 可能增加 10% 以上。

| 類型 | 原因 | 分析方式 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Static IR drop | 平均電流 × 電阻 | 用平均功耗（vectorless） |
| Dynamic IR drop | 瞬間大量 cell 同時切換（clock edge） | 用 VCD/波形或 vectorless 動態分析 |

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  PAD["VDD pad 0.80V"] --> R1["ring R"] --> R2["stripe R"] --> R3["rail R"] --> CELL["cell 0.74V"]
  CELL --> G["VSS 也有 bounce"]
```

| 改善方法 | 原理 |
| --- | --- |
| 加寬 ring / stripe、增加 mesh 密度 | 降低 R |
| 增加 power pad / bump | 縮短電流路徑 |
| 加 decap cell | 提供局部瞬間電流（dynamic） |
| 分散高功耗 cell、降低同時切換 | 降低局部 I |
| 增加 via | 降低層間電阻 |

### Corner cases & pitfalls
- IR drop 會讓 setup 變差；若 launch 與 capture 的壓降不同，也可能影響 hold。
- Sign-off 時 STA 應考慮 IR-aware timing（Voltus / RedHawk 結果回灌）。

### Follow-ups
- **IR drop 與 EM 的關係？** 都與電流密度有關，加寬金屬通常可同時改善。

title: 什麼是 crosstalk？對 timing 有什麼影響、怎麼解決
solution:
**Key idea:** 相鄰導線間的 **coupling capacitance** 讓 aggressor 的切換影響 victim：(1) **crosstalk delay**：反向切換使 victim 變慢（害 setup）、同向切換使 victim 變快（害 hold）；(2) **crosstalk glitch / noise**：victim 靜止時被耦合出 glitch，可能被 FF 錯誤取樣。

```wavedrom
{ "signal": [
  { "name": "aggressor",            "wave": "0.1...0..." },
  { "name": "victim (quiet)",       "wave": "0.10......" },
  { "name": "victim (同向, 變快)",  "wave": "0.1......." },
  { "name": "victim (反向, 變慢)",  "wave": "1..0......" }
],
  "head": { "text": "aggressor 上升 → 靜止 victim 出現 glitch；反向切換的 victim 被拖慢" } }
```

| 解法 | 說明 |
| --- | --- |
| 增加 spacing / NDR | 降低 coupling C |
| Shielding（兩側 VDD/VSS） | clock net 常用 |
| Upsize victim driver | victim 更有力抵抗 |
| Downsize aggressor / 降低 slew | 減少耦合注入 |
| 換層、縮短平行走線長度 | 減少耦合長度 |
| 插 buffer 切斷長線 | |

### Explanation
- STA 用 PrimeTime SI 計算 delta delay 與 noise bump，需 SPEF 中有 coupling cap。
- 先進製程導線更高更窄、間距小，coupling 比例提高。

### Corner cases & pitfalls
- Timing window 分析：aggressor 與 victim 若不可能同時切換（不同時間窗），不需悲觀計算。

### Follow-ups
- **clock net 為什麼特別要防 crosstalk？** clock 上的延遲變化直接變成 skew/jitter，影響所有 path。

title: 什麼是 electromigration（EM）？如何避免
solution:
**Key idea:** 高電流密度下，電子持續撞擊金屬原子使其遷移，長時間形成 **void（斷路）** 或 **hillock（與鄰線短路）**，是長期可靠度問題。電流密度 J = I / (W·t)，超過 foundry 規定上限即違規。

| 類型 | 發生位置 | 特性 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| DC EM（power EM） | power/ground 網路 | 單向電流，最嚴重 |
| AC / RMS EM（signal EM） | 高頻、高 fanout signal、clock net | 雙向電流，自修復部分，但有 Joule heating |

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  I["大電流 + 細金屬"] --> J["電流密度 J 過高"]
  J --> MIG["金屬原子遷移"]
  MIG --> VOID["void → open"]
  MIG --> HILL["hillock → short"]
  T["高溫"] --> MIG
```

| 解法 | |
| --- | --- |
| 加寬 wire / NDR | 降低 J |
| 增加 via 數量（via array） | via 是 EM 弱點 |
| 降低 driver strength、減少 fanout | 降低電流 |
| 分散 power、增加 stripe | 分流 |
| 換高層（較厚）金屬 | 截面積大 |

### Explanation
- Black's equation：MTTF ∝ J^(−n) · e^(Ea/kT)，電流密度與溫度越高壽命越短。
- 分析工具：Voltus / RedHawk（power EM）、Innovus/PT 的 signal EM 檢查。

### Corner cases & pitfalls
- EM 在晶片剛出廠時不會失效，而是在使用多年後才發生，所以必須在 sign-off 阻止。

### Follow-ups
- **EM 與 IR drop 的差別？** IR drop 是即時的電壓問題（timing），EM 是長期可靠度問題（open/short）。

title: 什麼是 antenna effect？如何修正
solution:
**Key idea:** 製程中 plasma etching 會在金屬上累積電荷；若一段長金屬只連到 transistor **gate**（還沒連到能放電的 diffusion），電荷會經由薄 gate oxide 放電而損傷甚至擊穿。以 **antenna ratio = 金屬面積 / gate 面積** 判斷。

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  DRV["driver (diffusion)"] -->|"M1"| JUMP["via up to M5 (jumper)"]
  JUMP -->|"M5"| DOWN["via down"]
  DOWN -->|"short M1"| GATE["receiver gate"]
  DIODE["antenna diode"] --> GATE
```

| 修正方法 | 原理 |
| --- | --- |
| Metal jumper（跳到高層） | 製造低層時長金屬被切斷，連到 gate 的金屬變短 |
| Antenna diode | 提供電荷放電路徑到 substrate |
| 插 buffer | 把長線切成兩段 |
| 縮短 net / 調整 placement | 降低 ratio |

### Explanation
- 製程由下往上逐層做；做到第 k 層時，只有 ≤ k 層的金屬存在。用高層金屬跳線，可確保 gate 在低層製造時只連到短金屬。
- Antenna 規則由 foundry 定義，DRC（Calibre）與 APR 工具會檢查並自動修正。

### Corner cases & pitfalls
- 加 diode 會增加 net 電容（略微變慢）與漏電。
- Cell LEF 中有 antenna 資訊（`ANTENNAGATEAREA`、`ANTENNADIFFAREA`）供 APR 計算。

### Follow-ups
- **為什麼連到 diffusion 就沒事？** source/drain diffusion 可以把電荷導到基板。

title: DRC 與 LVS 是什麼？如何做 LVS 驗證
answer: LVS 確認 layout 與 netlist 是否一致：將 APR 後的 netlist.v 和 GDS 轉為 .spi，比對兩者是否相同。
solution:
**Key idea:** **DRC**（Design Rule Check）檢查 layout 幾何是否符合 foundry 製造規則；**LVS**（Layout vs Schematic）檢查 layout 萃取出的電路與 netlist **是否一致**（元件、連接、尺寸）。

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  GDS["GDSII layout"] --> EXT["device + connectivity extraction"]
  EXT --> LNET["layout netlist (.spi)"]
  NET["APR netlist (.v)"] --> V2S["v2lvs 轉 spice"]
  V2S --> SNET["schematic netlist (.spi)"]
  LNET --> CMP["LVS compare (Calibre)"]
  SNET --> CMP
  CMP --> RPT["LVS report: MATCH / mismatch"]
  GDS --> DRC["DRC: width, spacing, enclosure, density, antenna"]
```

| 項目 | DRC | LVS |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 檢查什麼 | 幾何規則 | 電路連接一致性 |
| 典型錯誤 | spacing 不足、min width、via enclosure、density | short、open、元件不符、pin 名稱錯 |
| 輸入 | GDS + rule deck | GDS + netlist + rule deck |
| 工具 | Calibre DRC、ICV | Calibre LVS、ICV |

### Explanation
- LVS 流程：把 APR 輸出的 netlist（.v）用 v2lvs 轉成 spice，並把 GDS 萃取成 spice netlist，比對兩者的元件與節點對應。
- 常見 LVS 問題：power/ground short、標籤（label/text）錯誤、漏接 well tap、filler/decap 處理、IP 的 black-box 對應。
- ERC（electrical rule check）通常一起做：floating gate、well 未接等。

### Corner cases & pitfalls
- 標準元件在 LVS 時通常以 cell 的 spice（CDL）展開，需提供正確的 CDL。

### Follow-ups
- **DRC clean、LVS clean 就能 tape-out 嗎？** 還需 timing、IR/EM、antenna、density、DFM 等 sign-off。

title: 如何確定 APR 後的電路功能和 RTL 相同？（LEC / formal equivalence）
solution:
**Key idea:** 用 **Logic Equivalence Check（LEC）**：Formality / Conformal 以 formal 方法比對兩個設計的每個 compare point（FF、output）的邏輯函數是否相同，不需要 pattern，覆蓋 100%。

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  RTL["RTL"] -->|"LEC 1"| SYN["synthesized netlist"]
  SYN -->|"LEC 2"| DFT["DFT netlist (scan)"]
  DFT -->|"LEC 3"| APR["APR netlist (CTS buffers, sizing)"]
  APR -->|"LEC 4"| ECO["ECO netlist"]
```

| 步驟 | 說明 |
| --- | --- |
| Read reference / implementation | RTL（或前一版 netlist）與新 netlist |
| Setup | 告知 scan 關閉（`SE = 0`）、clock gating、常數、黑盒 |
| Match | 對應 compare points（依名稱、結構、signature） |
| Verify | 對每個 compare point 做等價證明 |
| Debug | non-equivalent / aborted 點分析 |

### Explanation
- APR 會改變 netlist（buffer、upsizing、CTS、scan reorder、hold fix），LEC 確保這些改動沒有改變功能。
- 為什麼不用 simulation？模擬只能覆蓋部分 pattern；LEC 是數學證明。
- 時序部分由 STA（+SDF post-sim）保證，LEC 只管功能。

### Corner cases & pitfalls
- Sequential 優化（retiming、FSM re-encoding、register merging）會讓 compare point 無法對應，需要額外設定或 SVF guidance 檔案。
- 未約束 scan mode 會導致大量 false non-equivalence。

### Follow-ups
- **LEC 會 abort 的原因？** 大型乘法器等複雜數學結構，需要 partition 或提示。

title: APR 常用的指令有哪些？（以 Innovus 為例）
solution:
**Key idea:** 依照 APR flow 順序記住主要指令：init → floorplan → power → place → CTS → route → opt → verify → output。

```tcl
# data prepare
set init_verilog   top_syn.v
set init_lef_file  {tech.lef cells.lef sram.lef}
set init_mmmc_file mmmc.tcl          ;# libs, RC corners, SDC per mode/corner
init_design

# floorplan
floorPlan -site core -r 1.0 0.7 10 10 10 10   ;# aspect ratio, utilization, margins
placeInstance u_sram 100 200 R0

# power plan
addRing   -nets {VDD VSS} -layer {top M9 bottom M9 left M8 right M8} -width 5 -spacing 2
addStripe -nets {VDD VSS} -layer M8 -direction vertical -width 2 -set_to_set_distance 50
sroute    -connect {corePin blockPin padPin}

# place + CTS + route
placeDesign
optDesign -preCTS
ccopt_design
optDesign -postCTS -hold
routeDesign
optDesign -postRoute -setup -hold

# verify + output
addFiller -cell {FILL1 FILL2 FILL4}
verify_drc
verifyConnectivity
extractRC
rcOut   -spef top.spef
write_sdf top_apr.sdf
saveNetlist top_apr.v
streamOut top.gds -mapFile gds.map
```

| 階段 | 主要指令 |
| --- | --- |
| 初始化 | `init_design` |
| Floorplan | `floorPlan`、`placeInstance` |
| Power | `addRing`、`addStripe`、`sroute` |
| Placement | `placeDesign`、`optDesign -preCTS` |
| CTS | `ccopt_design`、`optDesign -postCTS` |
| Routing | `routeDesign`、`optDesign -postRoute` |
| Check | `timeDesign`、`verify_drc`、`verifyConnectivity` |
| Output | `rcOut`、`write_sdf`、`saveNetlist`、`streamOut` |

### Corner cases & pitfalls
- 指令名稱依版本略有不同（新版 Innovus 有 `place_opt_design`、`route_opt_design` 等 common UI 指令）。

### Follow-ups
- **timeDesign 用途？** 各階段快速 timing 報告：`timeDesign -preCTS`、`-postCTS -hold`、`-postRoute`。

title: 先進製程在 back-end 會遇到哪些問題
solution:
**Key idea:** 製程縮小後，**wire 電阻與 via 電阻快速上升**、變異增加、電壓降低、規則變複雜：timing 由 wire 主導、IR/EM 更嚴重、需要 multi-patterning 與更多 corner。

| 問題 | 原因 | 影響 / 對策 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Wire / via 電阻大 | 金屬截面積小、barrier 比例高 | wire delay 主導 → 用高層金屬、via pillar、buffer |
| IR drop / EM | 電壓低、電流密度高 | 更密 power grid、backside power delivery |
| Variation | 隨機變異（RDF、LER） | POCV / LVF 分析，取代單一 OCV derate |
| Multi-patterning (DPT/SAQP) | 小於光刻解析度 | coloring rule、金屬方向限制 |
| Pin access / congestion | cell 變小，pin 密集 | cell padding、placement 限制 |
| FinFET 量化 | 寬度以 fin 數為單位 | sizing 離散 |
| Temperature inversion | 低 Vdd 下低溫更慢 | 更多 corner |
| Self-heating | FinFET 散熱差 | EM / 可靠度分析 |
| Corner 爆炸 | PVT × RC × mode | MCMM，執行時間長 |

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  SHRINK["製程縮小"] --> R["R ↑"]
  SHRINK --> V["Vdd ↓"]
  SHRINK --> VAR["variation ↑"]
  R --> T["wire delay 主導"]
  R --> IR["IR drop / EM"]
  V --> IR
  VAR --> OCV["POCV / LVF 簽核"]
```

### Explanation
- 面試時挑 3~4 個講深入（例如 wire R 上升、IR/EM、variation、DPT），比列一長串更好。

### Corner cases & pitfalls
- 前段設計者也需要知道：wire delay 主導代表合成時的 timing 估計更不準，要 physical-aware synthesis。

### Follow-ups
- **什麼是 LVF？** Liberty Variation Format，library 中描述每個 timing arc 的 sigma，用於 POCV。

title: LEF 檔和 DB（.lib）檔分別包含什麼內容
為什麼需要 DFT（Design for Testability）
solution:
**Key idea:** 製造過程會產生缺陷（short、open、變異），晶片出廠前必須測試。功能 pattern 很難控制與觀察內部節點；DFT 加入 **scan、BIST、boundary scan** 等結構，提高 **controllability 與 observability**，用 ATPG 自動產生高覆蓋率 pattern，降低測試成本與 DPPM。

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  FAB["製造"] --> DEF["defects: short / open / delay"]
  DEF --> ATE["ATE 測試 (scan / BIST)"]
  ATE -->|pass| SHIP["出貨"]
  ATE -->|fail| BIN["剔除 / 良率分析"]
```

| 沒有 DFT | 有 DFT |
| --- | --- |
| 只能用 functional pattern，覆蓋率低 | ATPG 可達 >99% stuck-at coverage |
| 內部 FF 難以設定與讀出 | scan chain 可直接 shift in/out |
| 測試時間長、pattern 難寫 | 自動化、pattern 數少 |
| 記憶體難測 | MBIST 內建 |
| 板級連線難測 | boundary scan (JTAG) |

### Explanation
- 越晚發現缺陷成本越高（rule of ten：晶片 → 板 → 系統 → 客戶，每一層成本 ×10）。
- DFT 代價：面積（scan mux、BIST）、少量 timing 影響、額外 pin；換取良率分析與品質。

### Corner cases & pitfalls
- DFT 不是驗證設計正確性（那是 DV），而是檢查**製造**出來的晶片是否與設計一致。

### Follow-ups
- **DV 與 DFT 的差別？** DV：設計是否符合 spec；DFT/test：晶片是否製造正確。

title: 畫出 scan flip-flop（SDFF），並說明 scan chain 如何運作
solution:
**Key idea:** SDFF = 一般 DFF 前加一個 **2:1 MUX**：`SE = 0` 選功能輸入 D（normal / capture），`SE = 1` 選 `SI`（shift）。所有 SDFF 的 Q 串接到下一顆的 SI 形成 scan chain，測試時：**shift in → capture → shift out**。

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  D["D (functional)"] --> MUX["2:1 MUX"]
  SI["SI (scan in)"] --> MUX
  SE["SE"] --> MUX
  MUX --> FF["DFF"]
  CLK["clk"] --> FF
  FF --> Q["Q / next SI"]
```

```wavedrom
{ "signal": [
  { "name": "clk",      "wave": "p........" },
  { "name": "SE",       "wave": "1...0.1.." },
  { "name": "scan_in",  "wave": "====x.===", "data": ["b3","b2","b1","b0","n3","n2","n1"] },
  { "name": "phase",    "wave": "=...==...", "data": ["shift in","capture","shift out / next in"] }
],
  "head": { "text": "SE=1 shift N cycles；SE=0 一個 capture cycle；再 shift out 同時 shift in 下一組" } }
```

| 模式 | SE | 動作 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Shift | 1 | chain 變成 shift register，載入 pattern / 移出結果 |
| Capture | 0 | 組合邏輯的反應被 FF 抓住 |
| Normal | 0 | 功能模式 |

### Explanation
- Scan 把 sequential 測試問題變成 combinational：每個 FF 都可直接控制（shift in）與觀察（shift out）。
- 測試時間 ∝ chain 長度 × pattern 數 → 用多條 chain 平行與 scan compression（EDT/DFTMAX）。

### Corner cases & pitfalls
- 跨 clock domain 串接需要 lockup latch；shift 頻率通常較低以避免 IR drop。
- Scan mux 增加 D 端延遲（setup 稍差）。

### Follow-ups
- **Scan 的 hold 問題？** Q 直接接 SI，path 很短，skew 大時容易 hold violation。

title: Test coverage 和 fault coverage 的差異
solution:
**Key idea:** **Fault coverage** = 偵測到的 fault / **全部** fault；**Test coverage** = 偵測到的 fault / **可測試**的 fault（扣除 untestable 的 fault，例如 tied、redundant、blocked）。所以 test coverage ≥ fault coverage，更能反映 ATPG 的品質。

Worked example（stuck-at）：

| 類別 | 數量 |
| --- | --- |
| Total faults | 100,000 |
| Detected (DT) | 97,000 |
| Untestable (UT: tied / redundant / unused) | 2,000 |
| ATPG untestable / aborted (AU) | 1,000 |
| **Fault coverage** = 97,000 / 100,000 | **97.0%** |
| **Test coverage** = 97,000 / (100,000 − 2,000) | **98.98%** |

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  ALL["all faults"] --> UT["untestable (structural)"]
  ALL --> TST["testable"]
  TST --> DT["detected"]
  TST --> ND["not detected / AU"]
```

### Explanation
- 業界通常以 test coverage 作為 sign-off 指標（例如 stuck-at ≥ 98~99%、transition ≥ 90%）。
- Possibly detected（PT，例如輸出 X）在某些工具中算半個。
- 這與 DV 的 **functional coverage / code coverage** 完全不同：那是驗證 spec 情境是否被測試到。

### Corner cases & pitfalls
- 提升 coverage：加 test point（control/observe point）、處理 X-source、讓 RAM 外圍可測（RAM bypass / shadow logic）。

### Follow-ups
- **為什麼會有 untestable fault？** 恆為常數的 net（tie-off）、redundant logic、只在 test mode 外存在的路徑。

title: 什麼是 scan reorder？為什麼要做
solution:
**Key idea:** 合成插入 scan 時還不知道 FF 的實體位置，chain 的串接順序通常是依名稱或任意的；placement 後依 **實際位置重新排列 chain 順序**，大幅減少 scan 繞線長度、congestion 與面積。

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  subgraph BEFORE ["Reorder 前 (依名稱)"]
    A1["FF1 (左上)"] --> A2["FF2 (右下)"] --> A3["FF3 (左下)"] --> A4["FF4 (右上)"]
  end
  subgraph AFTER ["Reorder 後 (依位置)"]
    B1["FF1 (左上)"] --> B4["FF4 (右上)"] --> B2["FF2 (右下)"] --> B3["FF3 (左下)"]
  end
```

| 項目 | Reorder 前 | Reorder 後 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Scan wire 長度 | 長、交錯 | 短 |
| Congestion | 高 | 低 |
| Hold 風險 | 跨長距離 skew 大 | 鄰近 FF，但 path 短需注意 hold |

### Explanation
- APR 工具讀 **SCANDEF**（描述 chain 的起訖點、可重排的 segment、固定順序部分），在 placement 後與 CTS 後重排。
- 限制：只能在同一 clock domain / 同一 edge 的 segment 內重排；lockup latch 與 chain 長度平衡要保持。
- Reorder 後 chain 順序改變 → 必須重新做 ATPG（或用新的 SCANDEF 產生 pattern），並做 LEC（scan mode 關閉時功能不變）。

### Corner cases & pitfalls
- 可做 chain 之間的 swap（partition）以平衡長度，但不能讓 chain 跨越 clock domain。

### Follow-ups
- **scan chain 很短的 Q→SI 路徑有什麼問題？** hold violation，APR 需插 delay buffer。

title: 什麼是 lockup latch？為什麼 scan chain 需要它
solution:
**Key idea:** Scan chain 跨越兩個 clock domain（或同 clock 但 skew 很大）時，Q→SI 路徑很短，若 **capture FF 的 clock 比 launch FF 晚到**，新資料會在 capture FF 取樣前就到 → **hold violation**。在兩段 chain 之間插入一個 **由 launch clock 驅動、clk low 時透明的 latch**，把資料延遲半個週期。

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  FA["last SDFF of domain A (clkA)"] --> LL["lockup latch (transparent when clkA low)"]
  LL --> FB["first SDFF of domain B (clkB)"]
  CA["clkA"] --> FA
  CA -->|"inverted enable"| LL
  CB["clkB (late)"] --> FB
```

```wavedrom
{ "signal": [
  { "name": "clkA",       "wave": "hlhlhlhl" },
  { "name": "clkB (late)", "wave": "lhlhlhlh" },
  { "name": "FA.Q",        "wave": "=.=.=.=.", "data": ["a0","a1","a2","a3"] },
  { "name": "latch.Q",     "wave": "x=.=.=.=", "data": ["a0","a1","a2","a3"] }
],
  "head": { "text": "latch 只在 clkA low 時更新 → FB 在 clkB 上升沿仍取到前一筆的資料" } }
```

### Explanation
- Latch 在 clkA high 時保持，資料最早在 clkA 下降沿才往前送，相當於給 hold 增加半個 clkA 週期的 margin。
- 位置：chain 中 clock domain 切換處、或同 domain 但 clock tree 分支差異很大的地方；DFT 工具（DFT Compiler / Tessent）可自動插入。

### Corner cases & pitfalls
- 若 clkB 比 clkA **早**到，則問題是 setup 而非 hold，lockup latch 不需要（但 shift 頻率低，setup 通常足夠）。
- 用 negative-edge FF 也能達到類似效果，但會讓 shift 少半個週期的 setup 時間。

### Follow-ups
- **為什麼不直接加 delay buffer？** skew 可能很大且隨 corner 變化，latch 提供固定半週期的 margin 更穩健。

title: 什麼是 BIST？MBIST 與 LBIST 的差別
solution:
**Key idea:** BIST（Built-In Self-Test）把 pattern 產生器與結果比較器做進晶片，晶片可自己測自己，減少對昂貴 ATE 的依賴、可做 at-speed、上電與 in-field 測試。

| 類型 | 測試對象 | Pattern 來源 | 結果判斷 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| MBIST | SRAM / ROM | March algorithm 狀態機 | 讀回值與預期直接比較 |
| LBIST | 隨機邏輯 | PRPG（LFSR）偽隨機 | MISR signature 比對 golden |

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  CTRL["BIST controller"] --> PG["pattern generator (March FSM / LFSR)"]
  PG --> DUT["memory / logic (CUT)"]
  DUT --> RA["response analyzer (comparator / MISR)"]
  RA --> RES["pass / fail, signature"]
```

March C− 演算法（MBIST 最常見）：

| 步驟 | 位址順序 | 動作 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| M0 | ⇕ | w0 |
| M1 | ⇑ | r0, w1 |
| M2 | ⇑ | r1, w0 |
| M3 | ⇓ | r0, w1 |
| M4 | ⇓ | r1, w0 |
| M5 | ⇕ | r0 |

### Explanation
- March C− 為 10N 複雜度，可偵測 stuck-at、transition、address decoder、多數 coupling fault。
- MBIST 常搭配 repair（redundant row/column + eFuse）提升良率。
- LBIST 需要設計 X-free（X 會汙染 MISR），並加 test point 提升隨機 pattern 覆蓋率。

### Corner cases & pitfalls
- BIST 本身也要被測試，且增加面積；MBIST 需要處理 memory wrapper 的 timing。

### Follow-ups
- **為什麼 memory 不用 scan 測？** memory cell 不是 FF，無法串成 scan chain，用 MBIST 更有效。

title: 什麼是 stuck-at fault？如何產生 pattern 偵測
solution:
**Key idea:** Stuck-at fault 模型假設某條 net 永遠卡在 0（SA0）或 1（SA1）。偵測步驟：**activate**（把該點驅動成相反值）→ **propagate**（讓差異傳到可觀察的輸出 / scan FF）。

例：`Y = (A & B) | C`，偵測 AND 輸出 n1 的 **SA0**

| 步驟 | 條件 |
| --- | --- |
| Activate | n1 正常值要是 1 → A = 1, B = 1 |
| Propagate | OR 的另一輸入不能遮蔽 → C = 0 |
| Pattern | A B C = 1 1 0 |
| Good / faulty | Y = 1 / Y = 0 → 偵測到 |

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A["A=1"] --> AND["AND"]
  B["B=1"] --> AND
  AND -->|"n1: good 1 / faulty 0 (SA0)"| OR["OR"]
  C["C=0"] --> OR
  OR --> Y["Y: 1 vs 0"]
```

### Explanation
- 每條 net 有 SA0 與 SA1 兩個 fault，N 條 net 共 2N 個 fault（fault collapsing 可去除等價 fault）。
- 一個 pattern 可同時偵測多個 fault；ATPG 工具（TetraMAX、Tessent）自動產生並做 fault simulation。
- Stuck-at 是靜態模型，偵測 short/open 類缺陷；時序缺陷要用 transition / path delay fault。

### Corner cases & pitfalls
- Redundant logic 中的 fault 無法偵測（untestable）。

### Follow-ups
- **bridging fault？** 兩條線短路，模型為 wired-AND / wired-OR / dominant。

title: 什麼是 transition delay fault？LOC 與 LOS 的差別
solution:
**Key idea:** Transition delay fault 模型假設某節點 **slow-to-rise / slow-to-fall**：transition 太慢，無法在一個 functional clock 週期內傳到 capture FF。測試需兩個 pattern：V1 初始化、V2 產生 transition，並以 **at-speed** 的 launch → capture 間隔檢查。

```wavedrom
{ "signal": [
  { "name": "clk",  "wave": "p.....|..." , "period": 1 },
  { "name": "SE",   "wave": "1.....|0.1" },
  { "name": "pulse","wave": "0.....|110" },
  { "name": "phase","wave": "=.....|==.", "data": ["shift (slow)","launch","capture"] }
],
  "head": { "text": "LOC：SE 拉低後送兩個 at-speed pulse（launch、capture）" } }
```

| 方法 | Launch 方式 | 優點 | 缺點 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| LOC（launch-on-capture，broadside） | 第一個 functional capture 產生 transition | SE 不需 at-speed | pattern 數多、覆蓋率略低 |
| LOS（launch-on-shift，skewed-load） | 最後一個 shift 產生 transition | 覆蓋率高、pattern 少 | SE 需在一個 at-speed 週期內切換（SE 要當 clock tree 一樣處理） |

### Explanation
- At-speed clock 通常由晶片內 PLL 透過 OCC（on-chip clock controller）產生，ATE 只送慢速 shift clock。
- 偵測的是製程造成的延遲缺陷（resistive via、weak transistor）。

### Corner cases & pitfalls
- 不能檢查 false path / multicycle path，需要在 ATPG 中套用 SDC exceptions，否則會過殺（overkill）。
- At-speed 測試的同時切換導致 IR drop，可能誤判 fail。

### Follow-ups
- **path delay fault？** 針對特定 critical path 的累積延遲，pattern 數多，通常只對少數關鍵 path 做。

title: 什麼是 boundary scan（JTAG）
solution:
**Key idea:** IEEE 1149.1 JTAG 在每個 I/O pin 加一個 **boundary scan cell（BSC）**，串成一條鏈，透過 TAP（TCK、TMS、TDI、TDO、TRST）控制，可以在**不需要探針**的情況下測試 PCB 上晶片之間的連線（open/short），也能讀取/設定 pin 值。

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  TDI["TDI"] --> BSC1["BSC (pin 1)"] --> BSC2["BSC (pin 2)"] --> BSC3["BSC (pin 3)"] --> BSC4["BSC (pin 4)"] --> TDO["TDO"]
  TAP["TAP controller (TCK, TMS)"] --> IR["instruction register"]
  TAP --> BSC1
  CORE["core logic"] --- BSC2
  CORE --- BSC3
```

| 指令 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| EXTEST | 由 BSC 驅動輸出 pin、擷取輸入 pin → 測板上連線 |
| SAMPLE / PRELOAD | 在正常運作時取樣 pin 值 / 預載 BSC |
| BYPASS | 1-bit bypass register，縮短鏈 |
| IDCODE | 讀晶片 ID |
| INTEST | 透過 BSC 測 core |

### Explanation
- TAP controller 是 16 狀態的 FSM，由 TMS 在 TCK 上升沿驅動（Test-Logic-Reset、Run-Test/Idle、Shift-DR、Update-DR 等）。
- JTAG 也被廣泛用於 debug（CPU debug port）、燒錄 flash、存取內部 MBIST/IJTAG（1687）網路。

### Corner cases & pitfalls
- BSC 加在 I/O 與 core 之間，會增加少量 I/O 延遲。

### Follow-ups
- **TMS 連按 5 次 1 會怎樣？** 從任何狀態都會回到 Test-Logic-Reset。

title: 什麼是 ATPG？如何產生測試 pattern
solution:
**Key idea:** ATPG（Automatic Test Pattern Generation）根據 netlist 與 fault model，自動找出能偵測每個 fault 的輸入 pattern：**fault activation → propagation → line justification**，再用 fault simulation 計算一個 pattern 能順便偵測哪些 fault，最後壓縮 pattern 數。

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  NET["scan-inserted netlist + SPF / test protocol"] --> FL["建立 fault list (SA / TDF)"]
  FL --> PICK["選一個未偵測 fault"]
  PICK --> GEN["D-algorithm / PODEM: activate + propagate + justify"]
  GEN --> FSIM["fault simulation：刪除被順便偵測的 fault"]
  FSIM --> MORE{"還有 fault?"}
  MORE -->|yes| PICK
  MORE -->|no| CMP["pattern compaction"]
  CMP --> OUT["STIL / WGL patterns + coverage report"]
```

| 輸入 | 輸出 |
| --- | --- |
| Netlist（含 scan）、library model | Test patterns（STIL/WGL） |
| Test protocol（scan chain、clock、SE） | Coverage report（test / fault coverage） |
| Constraints（test mode pin、SDC exceptions） | Untestable fault 清單 |

### Explanation
- 演算法：D-algorithm（用 D / D̄ 表示 good/faulty 差異）、PODEM（只在 primary input 做決策，搜尋更快）、FAN。
- Scan 把問題變成 combinational ATPG；compression（EDT、DFTMAX）用 decompressor/compactor 減少 ATE 資料量與測試時間。
- 工具：Synopsys TestMAX ATPG（TetraMAX）、Siemens Tessent、Cadence Modus。

### Corner cases & pitfalls
- X-source（未初始化 RAM、analog、bus contention）會降低 coverage，需要 X-masking 或 bounding。
- Pattern 要經過 timing-annotated simulation 驗證（serial / parallel sim）。

### Follow-ups
- **為什麼 pattern 要 simulation？** 確認 DFT 插入、clock 控制、timing 在實際 netlist 上正確，避免 ATE 上大量 fail。

title: Factory: replace a transaction type without editing the existing agent or sequences
prompt:
An existing `packet` class has 8-bit `src_id` and `dst_id` fields and a 16-bit `payload`. The agent and sequences must **not** be modified.

Write `priority_packet`, which extends `packet` and adds a random 2-bit priority:
- when `dst_id == 8'hFF` (broadcast) the priority must be non-zero;
- unicast packets are unrestricted.

At runtime, use the UVM factory to replace every `packet` with a `priority_packet`.
answer:
- Extend the class; existing code keeps referring to `packet` and the factory returns the subclass at create time.
- `priority` is a reserved SV keyword, so name the field `pri`. It is 2 bits wide, so no range constraint is needed.
- Use an implication `(dst_id == 8'hFF) -> (pri != 0)`; an unconditional `pri != 0` would wrongly restrict unicast.
- Register the override **before** `super.build_phase()` (before anything is created). `new()` bypasses the factory; only `type_id::create()` honors overrides.
- Per-agent replacement: `set_inst_override_by_type(orig, repl, path)`; the path must match `get_full_name()`.
- To read `pri` in a scoreboard, `$cast` to `priority_packet` first.
solution:
**Key idea:** subclass `packet`, register it with `` `uvm_object_utils ``, and install a factory type override *before* anything calls `packet::type_id::create()`. Old sequences still ask for a `packet`; the factory quietly hands them a `priority_packet`.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant T as my_test
  participant F as uvm_factory
  participant S as old_sequence
  T->>F: set_type_override_by_type(packet, priority_packet)
  T->>T: super.build_phase() builds env and agents
  S->>F: packet::type_id::create(pkt)
  F-->>S: priority_packet object behind a packet handle
  S->>S: randomize() also solves c_pri
```

### Solution
- **Extend, don't edit.** `priority_packet extends packet` inherits `src_id`, `dst_id`, `payload` (never redeclare them, that would shadow the parent fields).
- **Field name:** `priority` is a reserved keyword (`priority case/if`), so use `pri`. A 2-bit field is already bounded to 0..3.
- **Constraint:** an implication so only broadcast is restricted.
- **Override timing:** `build_phase` runs top-down, so in the test put the override *before* `super.build_phase()` (the base test's build creates the env, and sequences create items later in `run_phase`).

| Override API | Scope | Typical use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `set_type_override_by_type(packet::get_type(), priority_packet::get_type())` | every `packet` created anywhere | swap the whole TB |
| `set_inst_override_by_type(packet::get_type(), priority_packet::get_type(), "uvm_test_top.env.agt0.*")` | only matching `get_full_name()` paths | one agent only |
| `packet::type_id::set_type_override(priority_packet::get_type())` | same as the first row | shorthand from the class |

### Code
```systemverilog
class priority_packet extends packet;
  `uvm_object_utils(priority_packet)

  rand bit [1:0] pri;            // "priority" is a reserved keyword

  // Broadcast must carry a non-zero priority; unicast is unrestricted
  constraint c_pri { (dst_id == 8'hFF) -> (pri != 0); }

  function new(string name = "priority_packet");
    super.new(name);
  endfunction
endclass

class prio_test extends base_test;
  `uvm_component_utils(prio_test)

  function new(string name, uvm_component parent);
    super.new(name, parent);
  endfunction

  function void build_phase(uvm_phase phase);
    // original type first, replacement second
    set_type_override_by_type(packet::get_type(), priority_packet::get_type());
    super.build_phase(phase);    // base_test creates the env here
  endfunction
endclass

// Reading pri in a scoreboard
function void write(packet p);
  priority_packet pp;
  if (!$cast(pp, p))
    `uvm_error("SB", "got a plain packet: override not applied")
  else
    `uvm_info("SB", $sformatf("dst=%0h pri=%0d", pp.dst_id, pp.pri), UVM_HIGH)
endfunction
```

### Corner cases & pitfalls
- **Swapped arguments** mean "replace `priority_packet` with `packet`": the override appears to be set but has no effect.
- **`new()` instead of `type_id::create()`** anywhere in the old code bypasses the factory. An object that already exists never changes type.
- **Override registered too late** (e.g. in `run_phase` or inside a sequence's `body()` after items were created).
- **Instance override path** must match the *creating context's* full name; check with `factory.print()` / `uvm_top.print_topology()`.

### Follow-ups
- **Why not register the override inside a sequence's `body()`?** Items are created as soon as `body()` runs, so it arrives too late (and it is global anyway).
- **The override is registered but objects are still the base class.** The code calls `new()` instead of `type_id::create()`.
- **Scope of a type override?** Global: every `packet::type_id::create()` returns the subclass.
- **An instance override has no effect.** The path doesn't match the target's `get_full_name()`.

title: Scoreboard: align the golden model with a 1-cycle-latency MAC
prompt:
A streaming MAC takes signed `a[7:0]`, `b[7:0]` and `acc_in[15:0]` every cycle and produces

`acc_out = a*b + acc_in` **one cycle later**.

Write a UVM scoreboard that computes the expected value in `write()`, compares it with the DUT output, and reports `uvm_error` on a mismatch. Each monitor transaction carries this cycle's inputs and this cycle's `acc_out` pin value.
answer:
- `a`, `b`, `acc_in` are random; `acc_out` is an observed output and must not be `rand`.
- Push each prediction into a queue; pop the oldest only once the queue holds more than one entry (cycle 0 has nothing to compare).
- Widen before multiplying: `16'(tr.a) * 16'(tr.b)`; otherwise the product is computed in 8 bits.
- Compare with `!==` so an X on the DUT output is a mismatch.
- Connect `mon.ap.connect(sb.imp)` in connect_phase. For latency N, pop when size > N. Don't name a variable `ref` (keyword).

title: Parameterized interface: write stream_if with clocking blocks and driver/monitor modports
prompt: Write `stream_if` with a parameter `N` (4, 8 or 16). It carries `N` signed 8-bit data values plus a `valid` signal. Provide clocking blocks and separate **driver** and **monitor** modports. `clk` and `rst_n` are interface ports.
answer:
- Data is an unpacked array `logic signed [7:0] data[N]`, not one packed bus.
- Driver and monitor see opposite directions: one clocking block each.
- `input #1step` samples just before the edge; a small positive output skew (`#1`) drives just after it, so the DUT never sees the change on the same edge.
- Type the virtual interface with its modport (`virtual stream_if#(4).drv`); driving signals directly bypasses the clocking block.
- `stream_if#(4)` and `stream_if#(8)` are different types; config_db won't convert.

title: Virtual sequence: run a command stream and a data stream in parallel
prompt:
The command and data interfaces each have their own sequencer (`cmd_sequencer`, `data_sequencer`). Write:
1. a **virtual sequencer** that holds both handles,
2. a **layered sequence** that runs a command sequence and a data sequence in parallel,
3. the test `run_phase` that starts it.
answer:
- The virtual sequencer only holds handles: it generates no items and must not construct the lower sequencers. Assign the handles in the env's connect_phase.
- A sequence uses `` `uvm_object_utils ``; `` `uvm_declare_p_sequencer `` gives a typed `p_sequencer`, valid only after `seq.start(env.vseqr)`.
- Start each child inside `fork ... join` so both run and both finish.
- Raise/drop an objection around `start` in run_phase.
- Never start both children on the same sequencer (serialized onto one channel).

title: Constraints plus cross coverage for a memory transaction
prompt:
`mem_txn` has `addr[7:0]`, `access_type` (READ or WRITE) and `burst_len` from 1 to 8. A WRITE burst may only be 1, 4 or 8.

Write the constraints, a covergroup that covers all three fields and **crosses `access_type` with `burst_len`**, plus a `sample()` method.
answer:
- Constrain `burst_len inside {[1:8]}` first, then `(access_type == WRITE) -> burst_len inside {1,4,8}`; the implication alone leaves READ unbounded (`int` can go to 0 or negative).
- Construct the covergroup in `new()`. `randomize()` doesn't sample: call `sample()` after a successful randomize, before the driver touches the item.
- WRITE x {2,3,5,6,7} cross cells stay at zero by design: exclude them with `ignore_bins`; `illegal_bins` only fire if something bypasses the constraint.
- Don't create 256 address bins; two ranges are enough.

title: AXI read scoreboard: flag an RID that has no matching ARID
prompt:
A response with `rid = 2` appears on the AXI R channel, but no read with `arid = 2` was ever issued.

Write a scoreboard that tracks outstanding reads (reported by a monitor on each AR handshake and on each R burst completion), raises `uvm_error` on an unmatched response, and retires the ID once it is matched.
answer:
- Track each ID with an `int` counter in an associative array, not a 1-bit flag: one ID can have several reads outstanding.
- Increment on each AR handshake (`arvalid && arready`). On R, error if the ID is absent or zero; else decrement and delete when it reaches zero.
- Both imps carry `bit [7:0]`, so use `` `uvm_analysis_imp_decl(_arid) `` / `(_rid)` outside the class for distinct `write_arid`/`write_rid`.
- Retire once per burst, on the `rlast` beat. Sample only on `valid && ready`.
- In report_phase, report IDs still outstanding (AR with no response).
solution:
**Key idea:** an AR handshake *opens* a read for its ID, an R burst (its `rlast` beat) *closes* one. Keep a **per-ID counter** (`int outstanding[bit [7:0]]`); an R whose ID has count 0 is exactly the protocol error.

```wavedrom
{ "signal": [
  { "name": "clk",     "wave": "p......." },
  { "name": "arvalid", "wave": "01.0...." },
  { "name": "arready", "wave": "01.0...." },
  { "name": "arid",    "wave": "x==x....", "data": ["1", "1"] },
  {},
  { "name": "rvalid",  "wave": "0001..0." },
  { "name": "rready",  "wave": "0001..0." },
  { "name": "rid",     "wave": "xxx===x.", "data": ["1", "1", "2"] },
  { "name": "rlast",   "wave": "0001..0." }
],
  "head": { "text": "two reads with ARID 1 are matched; RID 2 at cycle 5 has no ARID" } }
```

| Cycle | event | `outstanding` after | result |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | AR id=1 | {1:1} | |
| 2 | AR id=1 | {1:2} | a 1-bit flag would lose this |
| 3 | R id=1, rlast | {1:1} | matched |
| 4 | R id=1, rlast | {} (entry deleted) | matched |
| 5 | R id=2, rlast | {} | **uvm_error: RID 2 has no ARID** |

### Solution
- Two analysis imps with the same payload type need `` `uvm_analysis_imp_decl `` to generate distinct classes and `write_*` methods.
- The monitor sends `arid` on every AR handshake and `rid` once per burst (beat with `rlast`), never on idle or stalled cycles.
- Decrementing on every beat would make the second beat of a burst look unmatched.

### Code
```systemverilog
`uvm_analysis_imp_decl(_arid)
`uvm_analysis_imp_decl(_rid)

class axi_id_sb extends uvm_scoreboard;
  `uvm_component_utils(axi_id_sb)

  uvm_analysis_imp_arid #(bit [7:0], axi_id_sb) arid_imp;
  uvm_analysis_imp_rid  #(bit [7:0], axi_id_sb) rid_imp;
  int outstanding[bit [7:0]];          // key width = ARID/RID width

  function new(string name, uvm_component parent);
    super.new(name, parent);
    arid_imp = new("arid_imp", this);
    rid_imp  = new("rid_imp",  this);
  endfunction

  // AR handshake (arvalid && arready)
  function void write_arid(bit [7:0] id);
    outstanding[id]++;                 // missing key starts at 0
  endfunction

  // Called once per burst, on the rlast beat (rvalid && rready && rlast)
  function void write_rid(bit [7:0] id);
    if (!outstanding.exists(id) || outstanding[id] == 0)
      `uvm_error("AXI_ID", $sformatf("RID %0d has no matching ARID", id))
    else begin
      outstanding[id]--;
      if (outstanding[id] == 0) outstanding.delete(id);
    end
  endfunction

  function void report_phase(uvm_phase phase);
    foreach (outstanding[id])
      `uvm_error("AXI_ID", $sformatf("ARID %0d: %0d read(s) never answered", id, outstanding[id]))
  endfunction
endclass
```

### Corner cases & pitfalls
- Key narrower than the ID truncates upper bits: different IDs collide in one entry.
- `outstanding.delete(id)` (parentheses); `delete[id]` is a syntax error.
- With multiple masters behind an interconnect, key on `{master, id}`.

### Follow-ups
- **Catch an AR that never gets a response?** Report every ID still in `outstanding` in report_phase (or a timeout per entry).
- **Also check data ordering?** Store a queue of expected data per ID: AXI keeps order *within* an ID, not across IDs.
- **SVA alternative?** A local-variable property `(arvalid && arready, id = arid) |-> ##[1:N] (rvalid && rid == id)`, but counting outstanding reads belongs in the scoreboard.

title: One agent class, multiple interfaces: configure active/passive and vif per instance
prompt: Several identical stream ports exist. `agent0` drives its port; `agent1` only monitors. Write the agent class **once** and use `uvm_config_db` to give each instance its virtual interface and its active/passive mode.
answer:
- The `set` context + path must resolve to the agent's full name: tb sets `"uvm_test_top.env.agent0"` with `null` context, agent calls `get(this, "", ...)`.
- `get` type must match `set` type exactly, modport included. A mismatched field name makes `get` fail: `uvm_fatal` with `get_full_name()`.
- Active agent builds driver + sequencer + monitor; passive only monitor. `is_active` defaults to `UVM_ACTIVE`.
- Don't hard-code "I am agent0" in the class; put differences in configuration. `set(null, "*", ...)` would give every agent the same vif.

title: Register sequence: write CTRL, poll STATUS until ready, then send data
prompt:
Write a sequence that:
1. writes `ctrl_value` to CTRL (address `0x0`),
2. reads STATUS (address `0x4`) until bit 0 is 1 (bound the polling),
3. writes `32'hDEAD_BEEF` to address `0x8`.

Use `start_item` / `randomize` / `finish_item`. The item `reg_seq_item` has `addr`, `data`, `read_write` (0 = write, 1 = read).
answer:
- Extend `uvm_sequence #(reg_seq_item)`; create a fresh item for every transfer.
- Order: `start_item`, constrained `randomize() with {...}`, `finish_item`.
- Read data is valid only after `finish_item` returns (the driver fills it in).
- `do-while` so STATUS is read before bit 0 is checked; after 100 polls, `uvm_error` and `return` (never `$finish` in a sequence).
- If `randomize()` fails, stop; don't send an unrandomized item. The test raises the objection around `seq.start`.

title: fork-join: configure two blocks in parallel, then start datapath traffic
prompt:
Block A and Block B each need **five control registers** written, and both configurations should run **at the same time**. The datapath must start only **after both are done**. The virtual sequencer has `seqr_a`, `seqr_b` and `seqr_dp`.

Write the configuration sequence and the top virtual sequence.
answer:
- One sequence class parameterized by `base_addr` (`32'h1000` for A, `32'h2000` for B); writes go to `base_addr + i*4`, `i = 0..4`.
- Use `fork ... join`: `join_none` doesn't wait, `join_any` waits only for the faster block.
- A and B are two separate objects on two separate sequencers; the datapath sequence starts after the `join` on `seqr_dp`.
- `foreach (int i[5])` is not legal syntax; you start sequence objects, not `seqr_a.start()`.

title: RTL: 4-bit counter that counts only on an enabled, completed valid/ready handshake
prompt:
Design a 4-bit synchronous counter.

- Inputs: `clk`, `reset`, `enable`, `valid`, `ready`. Output: `count[3:0]`.
- `reset` is **active-high and synchronous**.
- The counter increments only when `enable`, `valid` and `ready` are **all 1 in the same cycle**, and wraps from 15 to 0.
answer:
- `always_ff @(posedge clk)`; don't put `reset` in the sensitivity list (that makes it asynchronous).
- Check `reset` first so reset and increment are mutually exclusive; nonblocking `<=`.
- 4-bit `count + 1` wraps from 15 to 0 naturally.
- The TB reference count must wrap at 4 bits too; the monitor samples after the edge settles.
solution:
**Key idea:** a completed handshake is `valid && ready`; gate it with `enable`, give `reset` priority in a single `if / else if`, and let the 4-bit width provide the wrap.

```wavedrom
{ "signal": [
  { "name": "clk",    "wave": "p........." },
  { "name": "reset",  "wave": "1.0......." },
  { "name": "enable", "wave": "0.1....0.." },
  { "name": "valid",  "wave": "0.1.01...0" },
  { "name": "ready",  "wave": "0.101....." },
  { "name": "count",  "wave": "=..=..==..", "data": ["0", "1", "2", "3"] }
],
  "head": { "text": "count increments after cycles 2, 5, 6 only; valid without ready or with enable low does not count" } }
```

| Cycle | enable | valid | ready | count next |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2 | 1 | 1 | 1 | +1 |
| 3 | 1 | 1 | 0 | hold (stalled) |
| 4 | 1 | 0 | 1 | hold (no data) |
| 7 | 0 | 1 | 1 | hold (disabled) |
| any with count=15 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 0 (wrap) |

### Code
```systemverilog
module perf_counter (
  input  logic       clk,
  input  logic       reset,      // active-high, synchronous
  input  logic       enable,
  input  logic       valid,
  input  logic       ready,
  output logic [3:0] count
);
  always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
    if (reset)
      count <= '0;
    else if (enable && valid && ready)
      count <= count + 4'd1;     // 4'hF + 1 wraps to 4'h0
  end
endmodule
```

Matching reference model in the TB:
```systemverilog
bit [3:0] ref_cnt;               // 4 bits, so it wraps like the DUT
always @(posedge clk)
  if (reset) ref_cnt <= 0;
  else if (enable && valid && ready) ref_cnt <= ref_cnt + 1;
```

### Corner cases & pitfalls
- Two separate `if` statements (reset, then increment) let the increment override the reset.
- `@(posedge clk or posedge reset)` makes the reset asynchronous: contradicts the spec.
- A blocking `=` in `always_ff` makes other blocks reading `count` order-dependent.
- An `int` reference count diverges from the DUT at 16.

### Follow-ups
- **Is `count == 15 ? 0 : count + 1` needed?** No: same result as the natural 4-bit wrap.
- **Saturate instead of wrap?** `else if (fire && count != 4'hF) count <= count + 1;`
- **Assertion?** `assert property (@(posedge clk) disable iff (reset) !(enable && valid && ready) |=> $stable(count));`

title: RTL: 8-input fixed-priority encoder with valid (no X, no latch)
prompt:
Input `irq_req[7:0]`, bit 7 is the **highest** priority.

- `irq_id[2:0]` = index of the highest set bit; `valid` = 1 when any request is set.
- With several requests set, report only the highest.
- With no requests, outputs must not be X and must not infer a latch.
answer:
- `always_comb` with `valid = |irq_req` and a default `irq_id = 0` at the top.
- `priority casez` from bit 7 down, `?` only in lower undecided bits; items overlap on purpose, so not `unique`.
- `8'b0100_1000` gives 6, not 3. Avoid `casex` (hides X on inputs).
- The scoreboard reference model must also scan from high to low.
solution:
**Key idea:** scan from bit 7 down and stop at the first 1. `priority casez` with don't-care `?` in the lower bits does exactly that; a default assignment at the top of `always_comb` guarantees no latch and no X when nothing is requested.

| irq_req | irq_id | valid | why |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `0000_0000` | 0 | 0 | default, no latch |
| `0000_0001` | 0 | 1 | only bit 0 |
| `0100_1000` | **6** | 1 | bit 6 beats bit 3 |
| `1111_1111` | 7 | 1 | bit 7 always wins |
| `0001_0110` | 4 | 1 | |

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  R["irq_req[7:0]"] --> B7{"bit7?"}
  B7 -->|1| I7["id=7"]
  B7 -->|0| B6{"bit6?"}
  B6 -->|1| I6["id=6"]
  B6 -->|0| DOTS["... bit0?"]
  DOTS -->|1| I0["id=0"]
  DOTS -->|0| DEF["id=0, valid=0"]
```

### Code
```systemverilog
module priority_encoder (
  input  logic [7:0] irq_req,
  output logic [2:0] irq_id,
  output logic       valid
);
  always_comb begin
    valid  = |irq_req;               // reduction OR
    irq_id = 3'd0;                   // default: no latch, no X
    priority casez (irq_req)
      8'b1???_????: irq_id = 3'd7;
      8'b01??_????: irq_id = 3'd6;
      8'b001?_????: irq_id = 3'd5;
      8'b0001_????: irq_id = 3'd4;
      8'b0000_1???: irq_id = 3'd3;
      8'b0000_01??: irq_id = 3'd2;
      8'b0000_001?: irq_id = 3'd1;
      8'b0000_0001: irq_id = 3'd0;
      default:      irq_id = 3'd0;
    endcase
  end
endmodule
```

Loop form (scales to any width):
```systemverilog
always_comb begin
  irq_id = '0;
  for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)        // later (higher) i overwrites earlier
    if (irq_req[i]) irq_id = i[2:0];
end
```

### Corner cases & pitfalls
- Reversing the case order matches a lower priority first.
- `unique casez` would be wrong: the items overlap by design.
- `casex` treats X on the *input* as don't-care and hides X propagation in simulation.
- A reference model scanning from the LSB mismatches on every multi-request test.

### Follow-ups
- **Is `always comb` valid?** No, syntax error (`always_comb`).
- **If-else chain instead?** Fine, scanning from bit 7 down, but the final `else` must assign both outputs or a latch is inferred.
- **Round-robin instead of fixed priority?** Rotate the request vector by the last grant + 1, fixed-priority encode, rotate back.
- **Where does the reference logic live?** In the scoreboard; the monitor only samples and forwards.
